name: [🎉] Deceit Retreat
desc:
This is Deceit Retreat - an elimination game at a luxury getaway.

🎭 Play as an iconic character
🎯 Compete in exciting challenges
🤝 Make friends… or send them home
🗣️ Call out other players
🎬 Avoid The Checkout
💎 Discover new items & abilities

How far will you go… and who will you deceive to stay?
